subject.title: fix(whatsapp): normalize hosted JIDs consistently with Baileys

question: Should existing unresolved WhatsApp LID-form allowlist entries fail closed after upgrade, with `openclaw doctor --fix` migrating only uniquely verified LID-to-PN mappings and warning operators about the rest?
rationale: This determines the supported authorization and upgrade contract for existing users; code review cannot safely choose between preserving legacy access and enforcing the canonical E.164 policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt verified-only migration
options.body: Merge with the proposed policy: doctor converts only uniquely verified entries and runtime rejects unresolved LID allowlist identities until an operator repairs them.

options.title: Preserve legacy authorization temporarily
options.body: Require an explicit, documented transition mode or compatibility plan before rejecting unresolved legacy LID entries.

options.title: Pause for narrower policy design
options.body: Keep the PR open while maintainers define the intended authorization, warning, and recovery experience for unresolved mappings.

recommendation.title: Adopt verified-only migration
recommendation.body: Merge with the proposed policy: doctor converts only uniquely verified entries and runtime rejects unresolved LID allowlist identities until an operator repairs them.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch author has assembled the implementation and migration design, making them the best available routing candidate for the maintainer decision.
